messages:
kevin (CEO): Quick weekly sync — high level: we shipped Dedicated EU yesterday, early telemetry looks good (~2.1s p95, cost ~8% above US baseline). Thank you all :tada:
kevin (CEO): Priorities this week: 1) stabilise EU launch (latency/cost), 2) finish retention policy update + comms, 3) finalise Q3 Dedicated SKUs and pricing. Short and focused.
kevin (CEO): Two asks: can Eng leads review the EU runbooks and fallback policies by EOD Thu, and Legal/Product to sign off on the retention copy by Fri?
anya (VP Product): Noted — I'll circulate the retention draft in #product later today. Targeting sign-off with Legal on Friday morning.
sam (VP Eng): On runbooks: we saw increased KV cache misses in the first 12h after deploy; infra team rolling a small patch now to warm caches. I'll post rollout plan in #eng-runtime.
sam (VP Eng): ETA for patch: ~2 hrs. We'll monitor p95 and token cost. If anything above `2.5s` p95 we trigger the canary rollback.
tabitha (Head of Ops): Ops is enabling extra autoscale headroom for EU this week during business hours. Also starting extended on-call through Friday to squash any regressions faster.
kevin (CEO): Appreciate that. Ops — please coordinate with Customer Success for any impacted customers; we don't want surprises.
anya (VP Product): CS: I'm drafting a short FAQ + recommended messaging for customers who see small latency changes. Will post in support channel.
deploy-bot: deploy "eu-dedicated-v1" started by sam at 1901234620. Status: rolling -> 8/10 pods updated.
sam (VP Eng): Patch applied, cache warmers running. Early checks: p95 back to `2.0s`, cost delta down to ~+4%. Continuing to watch.
kevin (CEO): Nice — good containment. One operational policy note: we are moving to 90-day logs retention for non-compliance environments, per legal guidance. This affects hosted logs only; Dedicated/Private customers can opt in/out. More details in the retention doc.
tabitha (Head of Ops): We'll update the retention setting in Console + API flag. Ops will publish a migration window — tentatively next Tue.
anya (VP Product): We'll add a banner and email for customers who might be impacted. Sam, please flag any infra concerns for the migration.
sam (VP Eng): Will do. Quick FYI: quantized model variant A/B tests are showing 1-2% quality delta on a few eval sets; ops savings are promising but we'll hold off switching defaults until we have more eval coverage.
kevin (CEO): Good caution. Keep the A/B, expand eval suites. If anyone sees high-risk regressions, escalate to me.
kevin (CEO): Final quick metric report: Hosted p99 latency `~1600ms`, p95 `~420ms`, platform error rate `0.03%` (down 0.01pt WoW). Dedicated throughput up 12% QoQ. Cost per 1k tokens hosted `~$0.21` (preliminary).
kevin (CEO): Thanks team. Short week for many — heads down on EU stabilisation and retention comms. Check-ins tomorrow 10a for leads.
anya (VP Product): Copy. Sending retention draft in 30.
sam (VP Eng): Monitoring dashboard shared. Ping me for access.
tabitha (Head of Ops): On it.
kevin (CEO): One small win to end on — our open-source benchmark repo hit 5k stars overnight. Huge props to the team driving transparency. :clap:
